remarks: Prestigious Stony Point location nestled in the heart of Saugatuck with water views. Upscale, quaint and charming neighborhood of high-end homes.This is a two tiered lot, the lower lot is a possible ADU site, totally separate from where the main house can be built. Walk to the train station, dine at the nearby eateries, a quick drive to Longshore, Compo and downtown. The yearly common charges are for road maintenance. ROW in road (see map)
